This is a production material/component source, NOT a new redesigned screen. Retain detailed, sharp, coherent natural material grain, no repeated tiled squares, no extra decorative motifs. No locations, routes, figures, writing, numbers, symbols, logos or watermarks anywhere. All existing immutable-frame geometry should remain visually identical.

Use case: background-extraction / production game asset sheet.
Input image is the APPROVED Ashen Cartographer Old Mine UI, a STYLE AND INDIVIDUAL LOCATION REFERENCE. Create seven separate mine location vignettes matching its painted 2D oblique perspective EXACTLY: warm amber lanterns within dark timber/rock, charcoal and muted ashen stone, richly hand-painted sharp detail, grounded medieval dark fantasy. Do not redesign the places.
OUTPUT: landscape transparent PNG atlas, 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows. Each cell contains ONE complete isolated illustration, with generous transparent gutters. No image may cross its cell. No frame, no grid lines, no surrounding sheet material.
Row1 cells left-to-right: (1) Mine Entrance, wooden mine mouth with lantern; (2) Dusty Crossing, timber tunnel fork and lamplit iron supports; (3) Collapsed Cache, rubble-filled alcove and lantern; (4) Spider Nest, low tunnel with conspicuous white cobwebs.

Each vignette includes an organic uneven rock/ground silhouette around the cave, tapering naturally into alpha; no black rectangular background, no colored matte, no checkerboard painted into pixels. Keep object scale and facing coherent across all seven. They will be about 200x140 pixels in the game. No readable text, no parchment labels, routes, UI buttons, wax seals, characters, digits or watermarks. Real transparent background outside every silhouette.
